title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Watermelon 10ml Nic salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Watermelon Nic Salt E-Liquid combines the legendary Pinkman profile with a fresh fruit twist. This blend starts with the iconic Pinkman base of sweet Red Berries—featuring prominent Strawberry and Raspberry notes with subtle zesty Citrus hints—and layers in the crisp, clean taste of Watermelon. The Watermelon adds a lighter, refreshing dimension to the mix, softening the sharp citrus undertones while enhancing the overall fruitiness. It creates a balanced profile that offers a sweet, juicy inhale with a clean finish, perfect for those who find the original Pinkman slightly too intense. Formulated as a Nicotine Salt, this 10ml e-liquid delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, mirroring the sensation of smoking more closely than standard freebase nicotine. With a balanced 50VG/50PG ratio, it is perfectly optimised for use in low-powered starter kits and pod vape devices.
